headline: Skubal's $450M deal broke the logjam, and every team that lost him is now chasing the same three arms: Peralta, King and Rogers.

news.title: Blue Jays pivot to Freddy Peralta after losing Skubal
news.note: Toronto, which bid over $400M for Skubal, now has Peralta as its top target, per Jon Morosi. He's expected to sign for around $25M a year.

news.title: Skubal agrees with Mets: nine years, $450 million
news.note: The two-time Cy Young winner picked the Mets over the Dodgers, Blue Jays and Padres. It's the richest pitcher contract ever, $125M more than Yamamoto's.

news.title: Mets' World Series odds jump from +2200 to +1300
news.note: DraftKings moved the Mets to fifth-shortest after the Skubal deal. The Dodgers (+350) and Brewers (+500) still lead the board.

news.title: Loaisiga turned down the Mets and Blue Jays to rejoin the Yankees
news.note: Bob Nightengale reports both clubs had offers in. He took two years and $18M from New York.

news.title: Mets extend A.J. Ewing for eight years, $95 million
news.note: The 22-year-old center fielder gets a $25M club option for 2035 after a 97 wRC+, 25-steal rookie year with plus defense.
